DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 添付の資料は同じ方のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do the attached documents belong to the same person?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。これは名前を変える前の資料です。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧姓の資料であると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. These are from before I changed my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the documents are in your former surname. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申請書は現在のお名前ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The application is in your current name, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。資料の名前を自分で書き換えてはいけませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本を書き換えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I shouldn't rewrite the name on the documents myself, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not alter the originals. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 原本はそのままにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave the originals as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、二つの名前の関係を説明するには何が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名の関係を示す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then what do I need to show the relationship between the two names?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to show the relationship between the names. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が必要な資料を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check which documents are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い資料と今の本人確認書類を、別々に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新旧の資料を分けて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show the old documents and my current identification separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the old and new documents separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの受付で確認を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait for confirmation at this reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。名前が違う理由も担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者への説明を引き受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I'll also explain to the staff why the names differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to explain it to the responsible staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その点を引き継ぎます。原本をお持ちのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that on. Please wait while keeping the originals with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物はこちらです。お持ちになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is your luggage. Can you carry it?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 思ったより大きいです。徒歩なので、持ち方を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きさと徒歩での運搬問題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's bigger than I expected. I'm on foot, so I'd like to think about how to carry it.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the size and the difficulty of carrying it on foot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取の確認は済んでいます。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。受け取ったことと、すぐ運べるかは別ですね。ここで中を開けずに持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取確認と運搬可能性を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Having received it and being able to carry it immediately are separate matters. I'd like to take it home without opening it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish confirmation of receipt from the ability to transport it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱の底を支えて運ぶ方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: One way is to carry it while supporting the bottom of the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取っ手代わりにテープを引っ張るのはやめます。台へ置いて持ち直してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち直すための台を借りる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't pull on the tape as though it were a handle. May I set it on a counter and adjust my grip?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use a counter to adjust your grip. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの台を一時的に使ってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。片手の荷物をかばんへ入れて、両手を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両手を空ける準備を行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll put the items in one hand into my bag and free both hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare to free both hands. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口のところも狭いのでお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The exit is narrow too, so please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両手で支えられました。友人に迎えを頼んだので、外の邪魔にならない所で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 迎えを手配して待つ場所を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can support it with both hands now. I've asked a friend to pick me up, so I'll wait outside somewhere that isn't in the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Arrange a pickup and choose somewhere to wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、箱を落とさないよう出口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please head to the exit, taking care not to drop the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大皿のお料理を取り分けましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I portion out the food on the large platter?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が盛り付けを見たいそうなので、少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 分配を待つ理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend would like to see the presentation, so please wait a moment.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want the food portioning to wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you also take a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 料理だけ一枚撮ります。他のお客さんは入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影範囲を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take just one photo of the food. I won't include other customers.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify what the photo will include. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮り終わったら、お取り分けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll portion it out after you've finished taking the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は少なめ、私は普通の量でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分の量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: A smaller portion for my friend and a regular portion for me, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the portions for the two of you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 残りはほかの方に確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the other people about the rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。人数分を均等に決めず、本人に聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他の人の希望確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please ask each person rather than decide on equal portions for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the other people's preferences to be checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮影は終わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you finished taking the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終わりました。今、取り分けをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影終了後に分配を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please portion it out now.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for portioning after finishing the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お一人ずつ量を伺いながら分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KOMATSU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll divide it while asking each person how much they want.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お席で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a problem at your seat?

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供が音に驚いているので、外へ出たいです。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供の反応と退出希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is startled by the sound, so I'd like to go outside.
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe your child's reaction and say that you would like to leave. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路はこちらです。ほかの方は残られますか。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-03.translation: The passage is this way. Will the others stay?

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夫は席に残ります。私と子供だけ出ます。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退出する二人と残る人を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-04.translation: My husband will stay at the seat. Only my child and I will go out.
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two people leaving from the person remaining. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外で休んでから、戻るか決めて構いません。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can rest outside and decide afterward whether to return.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は戻る約束をせず、子供の様子を見ます。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再入場を子供の様子で決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't promise to return now. I'll see how my child is doing.
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide about re-entry based on your child's condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お荷物もお持ちください。

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 足元の袋を取ります。夫には出る方向を伝えました。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物と同行者への連絡を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take the bag by my feet. I've told my husband which way we're going out.
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your belongings and that you informed your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 段差のところはゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please go slowly at the step.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子供と手をつないで出ます。道を教えてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 退出方法と感謝を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hold my child's hand as we go out. Thank you for showing us the way.
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will leave and express thanks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらへどうぞ。落ち着ける場所までご案内します。
DLG-SC-ISK-NANAO-001-SHARED-11.translation: This way, please. I'll show you somewhere you can settle down.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご利用は大人二名ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。抱いている子供を人数に入れず答えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数申告から漏れた乳児を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I answered without including the baby I'm holding.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the infant omitted from your party count. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子様もご一緒ですね。年齢を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your child is coming too, then. May I ask their age?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 生後八か月です。料金がなくても申告が必要か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 年齢と登録の疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Eight months old. I'd like to check whether I need to declare the baby even if there's no fare.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the age and ask about registration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 料金と人数の登録は分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the fare and the number of people separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、大人二人と乳児一人として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全員の人数を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll ask for two adults and one infant.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the count to include everyone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベビーカーもお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have a stroller?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 折りたたんだものがあります。置き方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベビーカーの扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a folded one. Please tell me where and how to put it, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the stroller. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗船時の扱いを担当から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain how to handle it when boarding the boat.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 券を確定する前に、三人分の登録内容を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発券前の登録照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before finalizing the tickets, please show me the registration details for all three of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the registered details before ticketing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 人数を訂正して、確認用の内容をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll correct the party count and show you the details for confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その二枚を入口へ運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please take those two signs to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一枚だけ「受付」と書いてあります。二枚とも入口でいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の文面の違いを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only one says 'Reception.' Should both go to the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the difference in wording on the two signs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すみません。受付の一枚は机の横でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sorry. The reception sign should go beside the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、矢印の看板だけ入口へ運びます。向きも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配布先と矢印の向きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll take only the arrow sign to the entrance. I'd also like to check its direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the destination and the arrow's direction. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口から会場へ向くように置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please place it pointing from the entrance toward the venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通路を歩いて、来る人から見えるか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来場者の視点で位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll walk along the passage and check whether arriving visitors can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the position from a visitor's viewpoint. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 置いた後で写真を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me a photo after placing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人が通っていないときに、位置が分かる写真を撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配置写真の撮り方を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take a photo showing its position when nobody is passing by.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide how to photograph the placement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の板は私が運びます。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私は入口の一枚だけ担当します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 分担する看板を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll be responsible for only the one at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify which sign you are responsible for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、配置が終わったら写真で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the photo once the placement is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保護者の欄をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the parent or guardian field.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は付き添いの叔母です。電話番号は書けますが、同意も私がしてよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 叔母の付き添いと同意権限を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm the aunt accompanying the child. I can write my phone number, but am I also allowed to give consent?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are the accompanying aunt and ask about authority to consent. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡先と同意する方の扱いは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the contact details separately from who can give consent.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母親から預かった紙があります。自分の名前へ書き換えずに見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預かった紙を改変せず提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a paper the mother gave me. I'll show it without changing the name to mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the paper you were given without altering it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人との連絡は取れますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母親に電話できます。必要な確認があれば本人から説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母親への連絡方法を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can phone the mother. If anything needs confirming, I'll have her explain it herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain how to contact the mother. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同意の扱いは担当が資料を見て判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will review the documents and determine how consent is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、連絡が取れるだけで接種できるとは考えずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡可能と接種可を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll wait rather than assume the vaccination can go ahead just because we can contact her.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish being able to contact the mother from permission to vaccinate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 緊急連絡先の希望も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell us your preference for the emergency contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は私が一緒にいるので、私の番号の扱いも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の連絡先の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm here with the child today, so please also check how my number should be treated.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check how to treat the contact number for today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 付き添い、同意、連絡先の三点を担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the three points: accompaniment, consent, and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 空いた箱を重ねておいてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この一つは借りた箱のようです。全部同じ所に重ねていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空箱の所有が異なると指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This one seems to be borrowed. Is it all right to stack all of them in the same place?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that the empty boxes have different owners. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 底の印を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the marks on the bottom.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この箱だけ店の名前があります。現場の箱とは分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 底の印で借用品を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only this box has a shop name. I'll separate it from the boxes belonging here.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the borrowed item by the mark on the bottom. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返却はまとめて担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will return the borrowed boxes together.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、私が勝手に店へ返さず、返却用の場所へ運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却担当へ渡す方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then instead of returning it to the shop on my own, I'll take it to the return area.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand it over to the person responsible for returns. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中に魚や紙が残っていないか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check that no fish or paper is left inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中身は空ですが、伝票が一枚ありました。先に担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残った伝票を箱から分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's empty of goods, but there was one slip of paperwork. I'll give that to the person in charge first.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the remaining paperwork from the box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の数も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell them the number of boxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 借りた空箱一個と伝票一枚です。分けた状態で引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱数と伝票数を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: One borrowed empty box and one slip of paperwork. I'll hand them over separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the box count and paperwork count. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その一個を返却用の場所へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take that one box to the return area.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩の交代に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you hand over for the break rotation?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この箱はまだ途中で、七個しか入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中箱の数量を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But this box isn't finished yet; it only has seven items in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the quantity in the unfinished box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A full box has ten, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。あと三個ですが、完成箱の数には含めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残数と完成集計の除外を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. It needs three more, but I haven't included it in the completed-box count.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the remaining quantity and exclusion from the completed total. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 後任に分かる表示を付けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's put a label on it so the next person can tell.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「未完、七個」と書いて、口は閉じずに置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未完表示と未封を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write 'unfinished, seven items' and leave it open.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide on an unfinished label and leaving it unsealed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封をする前に、後任にも確認してもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before sealing it, please have the next person check it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人に七個を一緒に数えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後任と実数を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have them count the seven items together with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the actual count together with the next person. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録の時刻もお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻を書きました。後任も数量を確認したので、休憩へ入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻と確認済みを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written the time. The next person has checked the quantity as well, so I'll go on my break.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the time entry and completed check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 引継ぎを確認しました。休憩後はこの記録から再開しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed the handover. After the break, let's resume from this record.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the item you're looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。飾ってあるこの大きいものを一つください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示物を購入希望として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One of these large ones on display, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point to a display item as the one you wish to buy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは展示用の見本で、販売品はこちらの大きさです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a display sample. The items for sale are this size.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、食べる品はこちらですね。箱に入る数も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 販売品の実寸と箱数を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then this is the one to eat, right? Please also tell me how many fit in a box.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the actual size of the sale item and the number per box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四人に一個ずつ渡すので、四個用にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配布人数に合わせて箱を変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll give one each to four people. Can you make a box of four?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change the box to match the number of recipients. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい箱をご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide a smaller box.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。見本の飾りは付かなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示装飾を求めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. It's fine if it doesn't come with the sample's decoration.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you don't need the display decoration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 販売品四個で、お間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Four of the items for sale, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この大きさの四個です。自分で分けて渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 販売品の数と用途を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, four in this size. I'll divide them up and hand them out myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the sale item's quantity and intended use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、小さい箱に四個お入れします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll put four in the small box.
